booking.instructions: Start your project right here in chat - leave your name, email and a note about what you'd like to build, and the team will follow up by email.

fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. Leave your name and email here and the Stonehaven Landscapes team will follow up by email.

faqs.a: Design-and-build stonework and landscape construction: patios, stone walls, custom pizza ovens and outdoor cooking spaces, pool and hot tub backyard builds, and perennial gardens. Artisan stonework is the specialty.

faqs.q: Who will actually build my project?
faqs.a: Brian Moore, the lead mason, works on every project. He brings over 25 years of experience in masonry and landscape construction.

faqs.q: How much does a project cost?
faqs.a: Pricing isn't published on the Stonehaven website - each project is custom-designed around your property. Leave your details here and the team will follow up by email to talk through your project.

greeting: Hi there! I'm the Stonehaven Landscapes assistant - happy to help with stonework, patios, walls or outdoor living questions.
